posts.text: Presence of Robeco as a co-promoter gives the confidence of strong promoter pedigree. Company has almost all good ingredients like - higher equity mix at 91%, higher B-30 exposure, higher SIP percantage Higher active fund which is higher margin in nature to me only major concern is lack of growth seen in recent quarters. Given its smaller size, company should be able to outgrow industry. Seems very reasonably valued vis-a-vis peers as of now. Disclosure- Biased and not an investment reco.

posts.text: Hey everyone, Have not seen much discussion around this AMC. The return metrics, profit growth, AUM growth looks aligned or even better than peers. The only issue being it’s still “Canara”. I personally never invest in PSUs or even any companies related to PSUs. Having worked in banking, I know how govt banks operate even today after all the cleanup. And they always have an influence in the group companies like Life insurance, or AMC (no matter what is mentioned in the annual reports about AMC being separately operated companies).
